title: Microfluidic Production of Lysolipid-Containing Temperature-Sensitive Liposomes
protocol: Assemble the syringe pumps and SHM.
Connect the "To Computer" port of Pump 02 to the "To Network" port of Pump 01 using a network cable.
Connect the "To Computer" port of Pump 01 to the RS232 Serial port of the computer using another network cable.
Attach tubing to each inlet and outlet of the SHM using nuts and ferrules.
Convert the terminal of the tubing for both inlets to female Luer using additional nuts, ferrules, and a union assembly.
Set up pump control software on the computer.
Assign Pump 01 address to "Ad:01" and Pump 02 address to "Ad:02".
Open the pump control software; detect Pumps 01 and 02 automatically or search for them manually if needed.
Select "HSW Norm-Ject 5 cc (Dia=12.45)" with a diameter of 12.45 mm.
Assign a rate of 0.25 mL/min to Pump 01.
Assign a rate of 0.75 mL/min to Pump 02.
Assign a volume for values above 5 mL.
Select INF mode for both pumps and confirm settings by pressing Set.
Prepare a LTSL10 or LTSL10-ICG lipid mixture.
Withdraw 1 mL of lipid mixture using a 5 mL Luer lock syringe.
Withdraw at least 3 mL of (NH4)2SO4 solution using another 5 mL Luer lock syringe.
Install both syringes onto the syringe pumps in the upright position.
Wrap one end of the heating tape to the syringe with the aqueous solution.
Wrap the other end of the heating tape and temperature probe around the syringe with the lipid solution.
Connect the two syringes to the female Luer adaptors corresponding to ethanol inlet and aqueous inlet.
Adjust plunger positions to remove air bubbles from the syringes.
Heat up the syringes to above 51°C using the heating tape for 10 s.
Allow the thermostat to update the temperature of the syringes.
Run the syringe pumps by pressing Run All in the pump control software.
Ensure the fluid flow is free of air bubbles and any leakage.
Dispose the initial volume (around 0.5 mL) of liquid from the outlet as waste.
Collect the rest of the liquid as liposome samples into a microcentrifuge tube or bijou vial.
Pause/stop the infusion when the liquid in either of the syringes is almost empty.
Place the collected liposome solutions in a 60°C water bath to anneal for 1.5 h.
Transfer the solutions to dialysis tubes.
Dialyze the solutions against 1 L of 240 mM (NH4)2SO4 at 37 °C for at least 4 h to obtain purified liposomes.
Incubate LTSLs with doxorubicin (DOX).
Add DOX solution in 1:20 DOX-to-phospholipid molar ratio into 1 mL of buffer-exchanged liposomes solution contained in a bijou vial.
Place the bijou vial in a 37 °C water bath for 1.5 h.
Mix 10 µL of liposomes with 170 µL of HBS and 20 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 solution in a black 96-well plate.
Repeat the mixing step for three wells.
Mix 40 µL of liposomes with 160 µL of DMSO in a clear 96-well plate.
Purify the liposome solution as described in step 3.1.
Clean the column from free DOX by adding 1 mL of diluted 0.5 M NaOH solution.
Mix 30 µL of purified liposomes with 150 µL of HBS and 20 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 solution in a black 96-well plate.
Repeat the mixing step for three wells.
Measure the DOX fluorescence intensity of the wells before purification using a microplate reader (λex = 485 nm, λem = 590 nm).
Mix 40 µL of purified liposomes with 160 µL of DMSO in a clear 96-well plate.
Repeat the mixing step for three wells.
Measure the DOX fluorescence intensity of the wells after purification using a microplate reader (λex = 485 nm, λem = 590 nm).
Calculate the encapsulation efficiency of DOX by taking the ratio of fluorescence intensities before and after purification.
Measure the ICG absorbance of the wells before and after purification, using a microplate reader from 600 to 1000 nm.
Calculate the encapsulation efficiency of ICG by taking the ratio of absorbance at 792 nm before and after purification, accounting for a threefold dilution factor during purification.
Add 50 μL of liposomes solution to 450 μL of deionized water.
Place the cuvette inside the DLS instrument and perform the measurement according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Record the mean Z-average diameter and dispersity from three measurements for each sample.
Concentrate 1 mL of liposomes samples with a centrifugal filter unit to 0.5 mL (final lipid concentration of 10 mM).
Spin at 7500 x g for approximately 15 min using a fixed-angle rotor.
Transfer 20 μL of (NH4)2SO4 solution and liposomes samples to two respective DSC pans.
Seal the pans with DSC hermetic lids using the DSC sample press kit.
Measure the sample from 30 °C to 60 °C at a heating rate of 1 °C/min using a differential scanning calorimeter.
Analyze the data with appropriate software.
Preheat HBS at 37 or 42 °C using a water bath.
Prepare an ice water bath for quenching samples.
Add 100 µL of purified DOX-loaded liposomes into 1.9 mL of HBS in a microcentrifuge tube.
Place the tube containing HBS and liposomes into the water bath at the designated temperature.
Withdraw immediately 200 µL of sample from the tube and quickly place it in the ice water bath to quench any subsequent drug release.
This sample corresponds to the initial (t = 0) time point.
Withdraw 200 µL of samples at subsequent time points (t = 5, 10, 15, 30, 60 min) and quickly place it in the ice water bath to quench any drug release.
Mix 50 µL of sample from each time point with 150 µL of HBS in a black 96-well plate.
Measure the DOX fluorescence intensity using a plate reader.
Add 20 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 into random selected wells prepared previously.
Measure the DOX fluorescence intensity of these wells using a plate reader.
These values correspond to the fully released (t = ∞; 100% release) time point.
Calculate and plot the percentage of DOX released by interpolating the fluorescence intensity of each time point, compared to the initial and fully released value.
Set water bath temperature to 37 °C.
Allow temperature to stabilize in water bath.
Add 200 µL of DOX loaded LTSL10-ICG ([ICG] = 10 µg/mL) to a clear 96-well plate.
Place the 96-well plate in the water bath with bottom immersed in water.
Set laser system current to 2.27 A.
Place collimator of laser system at 5 cm vertically above surface of 96-well plate.
Switch on laser and monitor temperature every minute using fiber optic temperature probe.
Withdraw 10 µL of laser-irradiated liposomes from clear 96-well plate after 5 min.
Mix withdrawn liposomes with 190 µL of HBS for three wells in a black 96-well plate.
Mix 10 µL of the liposomes with 170 µL of HBS and 20 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 solution for three wells in a black 96-well plate after 5 min.
Withdraw 10 µL of laser-irradiated liposomes from clear 96-well plate after 10 min.
Mix withdrawn liposomes with 190 µL of HBS for three wells in a black 96-well plate after 10 min.
Mix 10 µL of the liposomes with 170 µL of HBS and 20 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 solution for three wells in a black 96-well plate after 10 min.
